title: Lessons vs Work Products
principle: His lessons go in instantly with no gate; agent work products need independent verification — never confuse the two.

source.context: His correction separating lesson capture from work verification.

evidence.note: Agent capability claims demoted for missing verification — correctly, under this law.

applicability.decisions: Whether something needs independent verification before counting.
